method: OpenStreetMap way 171900953 (building=yes, man_made=telescope, name='H.E.S.S. 2'), a closed 7-node polygon used verbatim, no simplification. Replaces the earlier point that re-used the array's published coordinate. Four distance checks measure its centroid to each corner telescope's centroid against 120 m / sqrt(2), the centre-to-corner distance of the published 120 m square with CT5 at its centre.
name: H.E.S.S. CT5 telescope (28 m, centre of the array)
notes: The OSM tag on this way gives telescope:diameter=25m, but the Puhlhofer 2024 review states a reflector diameter of 28 m; the OSM tag is not used.

summary.plain: H.E.S.S.'s large 28-metre central telescope, added in 2012 at the middle of the original four-telescope square.
